title: RGFC: Registry Grounded Function Calling with stage-decomposed evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.18622v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-calling evaluations often report whether the final call matches a reference answer, but this single outcome merges different failures: choosing a function outside the available registry, violating the selected schema, or filling arguments with values not supported by the user request. These failures matter more when models must choose from larger tool registries. We introduce RFCD, a registry-scaled function-calling benchmark built from BFCL, Glaive Function Calling v2, and Tool-Call-Data, with standardized JSON-schema registries ranging from 5 to 3,000 functions. We also introduce TAAG, a deterministic stage-decomposed evaluator for registry conformance, structural completeness, and argument grounding. Across six locally served sub-4B models, three data sources, and four feedback modes, registry scale is the dominant source of degradation: single-pass TAAG pass rate drops sharply from small to large registries on all sources. translated_title: RGFC：基于注册表的函数调用与阶段分解评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.18622v1 公告类型：新 摘要：工具调用评估通常只报告最终调用是否与参考答案匹配，但这一单一结果将不同的失败混为一谈：选择了可用注册表之外的函数、违反所选函数的架构规范，或使用了用户请求不支持的参数值填充参数。当模型必须从更大的工具注册表中进行选择时，这些失败问题更为突出。我们提出了 RFCD，这是一个基于 BFCL、Glaive Function Calling v2 和 Tool-Call-Data 构建的注册表规模函数调用基准，包含规模从 5 到 3,000 个函数的标准化 JSON-schema 注册表。我们还提出了 TAAG，一个用于评估注册表一致性、结构完整性和参数溯源的确定性阶段分解评估器。在六个本地部署的 4B 以下参数模型、三个数据源和四种反馈模式的实验中，注册表规模是性能退化的主导因素：在所有数据源上，单次通过 TAAG 的通过率从小注册表到大注册表均急剧下降。
tldr: 该论文提出注册表规模函数调用基准 RFCD 与确定性阶段分解评估器 TAAG，并发现工具注册表规模（5 至 3,000 个函数）是模型函数调用性能退化的主要来源。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RFCD, a registry-scaled function-calling benchmark, and TAAG, a deterministic stage-decomposed evaluator, finding that tool registry scale (5 to 3,000 functions) is the dominant source of function-calling performance degradation.
